methods.name: MCP regression tools through call_tool_with_session: glmnet JSON, GLS rho
methods.reference: glmnet::glmnet, glmnet::cv.glmnet, nlme::gls (the R cases of each method)
quantities: glmnet coefficient path (lasso, ridge, binomial) and default path lambdas/df; cv coefficients equal the library's; the selection summary precedes the path in the reply
GLS rho, coefficients, SEs, sigma, log-likelihood, AIC, BIC (REML, ML, fixed rho; CS within groups, AR(1))
methods.tolerance: glmnet coefficients 1e-3 absolute at MCP's thresh 1e-7 (an R port of p2a's coordinate descent lies at most 1.7e-4 from the exact minimiser on these fits), deviance ratios 1e-5 absolute, default path lambdas Tol::coef(150), df exact; GLS coefficients Tol::coef(n), SEs Tol::se(n), sigma, log-likelihood, AIC, BIC Tol::stat(n), rho 1e-6 relative
